title: Lentil & Walnut Bolognese
description: A plant-based Bolognese packed with green lentils, walnuts and mushrooms over whole wheat pasta.
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic, carrots and mushrooms.
Stir in the lentils, walnuts, tomatoes and tomato paste, then simmer 25 minutes.
Cook the pasta and serve the sauce on top with parmesan.
notes: Green lentils hold their shape better than red here, giving a proper Bolognese-like texture.
